many-to-one.name: qualityControlTemplate
many-to-one.title: Model for quality control
many-to-one.help: You can select here the email template sent by default when a quality control is completed.

boolean.name: automaticMail
boolean.title: Automatic mail by completing quality control
boolean.help: When this configuration is enabled, an email will be sent automatically each time a quality control is completed.

boolean.name: redirectNonCompliantReceptionToQuarantine
boolean.title: Redirect non-compliant reception lines to quarantine
boolean.help: Disabled by default. When enabled, the received quantity of a non-compliant supplier reception line is moved to the quarantine stock location at realization, instead of its destination. The quarantine stock location must then be configured on the destination stock location or in the quality configuration of the company, otherwise the realization is blocked.

boolean.name: createQiOnNonCompliantReception
boolean.title: Create a quality improvement on non-compliant reception lines
boolean.help: Disabled by default. When enabled, a quality improvement is created automatically for each non-compliant supplier reception line at realization, using the detection for reception non-conformities of the quality configuration of the company.
